variablesPanel.label: Label
variablesPanel.labelPlaceholder: Name shown in the Variables view
variablesPanel.helpPlaceholder: Shown under the field in the Variables view
variablesPanel.placeholderPlaceholder: Shown while the field is empty
variablesPanel.inheritedHint: Read only. These come from scopes above this request. A variable with the same name above wins here.
variablesPanel.typeNote: A typed variable reaches scripts as that type. Inside a URL, header or body it is still written as text.
variablesPanel.useRowHint: Switch the variable on or off. A variable that is off is not sent, not checked and not shown in the Variables view.
variablesPanel.offOptions: This variable is switched off, so these options have no effect: it is not sent, not checked and not shown in the Variables view. Turn it on with the checkbox at the start of its row.
variablesPanel.inFormHint: A hidden variable is still sent with the value set here, and still checked. To stop sending it, switch it off with the checkbox at the start of its row.
variablesPanel.shownDespiteHidden: This variable needs a value it does not have, so the Variables view shows it anyway. Give it a value here to keep it hidden.
variablesPanel.markHidden: Hidden from the Variables view, still sent
variablesPanel.markShownDespiteHidden: Hidden, but shown in the Variables view until it has a value
variablesPanel.sessionReplaces: A session value with this name is used instead of this value, and it has to fit the type. A field in the Variables view is used instead of the session value, even when it is empty.

variablesView.emptyDescription: Variables added in the Vars tab of the full editor appear here as input fields.
variablesView.noFieldsDescription: This request has variables, but they are switched off or hidden from the Variables view. Change that in the Vars tab of the full editor.
variablesView.resetHint: Go back to the values saved with the request
